consistency_checks.worldcover_subset_of_glad: 97.8% of WC2021 built px fall inside GLAD built mask
consistency_checks.definitional_caveat: GLAD built-up (12.2% of district) >> WorldCover 2021 built (0.8%). This is a definitional gap, not an error: GLAD's CNN class marks ANY Landsat pixel containing a man-made surface (roads, scattered houses) — Kerala's dispersed settlement inflates it — while WorldCover class 50 is strict built-up surfaces. GLAD's own validation reports area above urban statistics for this reason. H1 primary uses GLAD (consistent Landsat epochs 2000/2020); the strict-built sensitivity uses WorldCover 2021. Direction of the treatment/control contrast must be checked to agree across both (prereg §3 H1 robustness clause).
